comment: A candidate for accession (European Council decision of 15 December 2022)
and not a Member State: the common system of VAT of Directive 2006/112/EC
does not reach it, exactly as it does not reach Turkey and Ukraine above.

territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries, candidate for accession or not. Bosnia and Herzegovina levies a value added tax of its own under the Law on Value Added Tax ("Official Gazette of Bosnia and Herzegovina", No. 9/05, 35/05 and 100/08), article 23, which sets the single rate at 17 %.
